description: Annual sectoral intervention budget for a locality programme
Heritage and development-control restrictions apply near Charminar precinct
Metropolitan Regional Development Plan growth corridors prioritise public transport investments
Ambient AQ standards must not degrade below CPCB national ambient air quality standards
Feeder work requires a shutdown window and coordination with distribution planning
Any trenching near water mains requires joint survey and surface restoration
Signal modifications require careful timing during non-peak and minimal lane closure
Local civic works should be completed within one financial year where possible
Land availability for new depot/substation requires statutory land-use conversion
Tree removal requires GHMC Arboriculture approval and compensatory planting
